verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right order: a one-line 'Sunset Sessions' headline, then the date block, the stacked pills and the RSVP button. But the two-line subhead and the date details are only a few pixels tall, the logo strip above the headline is microscopic, and the three pills crowd the middle, so it is still far from shippable. B squeezes the subhead into a narrow five-line column of unreadable text and breaks the headline over two lines, which makes it smaller. It also wedges the can illustration against the left edge and adds an illegible URL under RSVP, so it is more cramped and jumbled than A.
